episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: While fulfilling her part of the deal with a so-called "fairy," young Sun Mi makes a critical mistake that catches up with her 25 years later.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Desperate for help in dealing with Oh Gong, Sun mi seeks out Devil King Woo, who, as the head of an entertainment agency, is judging for an audition.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Geumganggo works its magic on Oh Gong, he gets frustrated by the conflicting feelings he has toward Sun Mi. Meanwhile, a young woman goes missing.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: To get Oh Gong off his back, Devil King is forced to make a big compromise. Oh Gong brings something -- or someone -- very stinky to Devil King's house.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Devil King donates an object of cultural importance to a museum, where historical artifacts on exhibit still bear the souls of the original owners.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Loyal Ms. Ma can't allow herself to just watch as Devil King suffers. Sun Mi feels torn as she knows all too well that Oh Gong's love isn't real.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Devil King Woo seeks Sun Mi's help in dealing with a troublesome prince who refuses to return home until he finds a runaway mermaid.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: When the plan to make Oh Gong jealous misfires, Devil King shows Sun Mi something to provoke her. An evil spirit is using social media to spread hate.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Sun Mi can't stop thinking about the moment the bell rang and what it means for her. An evil spirit is suspected of stealing children's souls.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: The fulfillment of Sun Mi's wish to be ordinary has far-reaching consequences on not only Oh Gong but also Devil King Woo, Richie and even Pal Gye.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: An assailant attacks Devil King Woo at a torch relay. Richie prepares to say her goodbyes. Ms. Ma finds out that a black bell has gone missing.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Oh Gong realizes that the Geumganggo has the power to take his life. Kang Dae Sung devises a plan to get rid of his annoyances altogether.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Asanyeo pursues what she didn't achieve more than 1,000 years ago. Aware of Devil King Woo's weakness, she decides to use it to her advantage.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Relentless in her desire to be stronger, Asanyeo orders General Winter to get her incense burner back. Sun Mi mentions the love bell to Oh Gong.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: To avoid exacerbating the dilemma regarding Asanyeo, Oh Gong must pretend not to know the truth, and General Winter must be found as soon as possible.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: In an uncanny dream, a woman shows Oh Gong the moment that Samjang was born. Asanyeo demonstrates what she's capable of doing for Kang Dae Sung.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: Oh Gong refuses to accept his and Sun Mi's fates. Devil King Woo wants to believe Asanyeo despite others' warnings that he's being deceived.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: As Oh Gong prepares to sacrifice himself in place of Sun Mi, Devil King Woo, feeling sorry for both, tries to solve the mystery behind the Geumganggo.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: While Sun Mi is away at the Lotus Village trying to figure out exactly what her mission is, Oh Gong hurries to begin the ritual to summon the dragon.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Both the Spiritual Realm and Devil King Woo try to get Oh Gong to come out of Sureumdong, where he's shut himself in after the fateful day.
